text: 🇲🇽🌎 Sheinbaum: a US trade deal — but "within the framework of sovereignty." 🇲🇽🛢️ <u>Diesel tax held at zero to shield prices from an oil spike</u>

For a second straight week Hacienda is holding the diesel IEPS at zero — a 100% stimulus worth 7.36 pesos a liter — and widened the Magna break to 4.20 and Premium to 3.34 pesos, a fiscal shield costing 393–481 million pesos a day, per El Economista. The move answers a 9%-plus jump in world oil prices from Middle East tensions, keeping fuel from feeding into transport, food and inflation.

🏠🇲🇽 <u>667,000 Bienestar homes under contract</u>

Mexico's Vivienda para el Bienestar program now has 667,000 homes under contract across 766 projects — 277,000 already under construction — backed by 75.9 billion pesos, hitting 37% of the six-year goal of 1.8 million units aimed at 12 million families. Sedatu puts the investment near 1.2% of GDP a year, generating about four jobs per home — a public housing build-out at a scale the market never delivered.
